summary: Multiproyectos feature tested end-to-end (backend pytest 13 tests + Playwright UI flow) using only self-created TEST_ clients/quotes/serial_assignments, all cleaned up afterwards. 12/13 backend tests pass: entities (grupo/marca/rif, invalid level 400, no-auth 401), search eligibility (excludes Borrador, archived, already-sent, linked-in-proyecto_cotizaciones; equipment_count counts preasignado+asignado only, ignores liberado), preview (<2 and duplicate ids -> 400, ineligible -> 400, level Multi-Marca, 2 under RIF A / 3 under RIF B, origen=warehouse name), create (is_multiproject, project_type multirif, 2 rifs/2 stores, quote_numbers, equipments_by_rif 2+3, equipments 5, instructions), quotes 'Enviada a Imple'+archived, quote_history multiproject_comment, proyecto_cotizaciones 1 row per quote, serial_assignments get project_id, second create -> 400, search empty afterwards, Ficha Técnica PDF (/api/projects/{id}/ficha-tecnica) has 'RIF / Sucursal' column with serials. FAILED: if the primary (oldest) quote has branch_details, the project is created as 'multistore' with ONLY the primary quote's store (other RIFs/stores lost). UI: full flow works (level chips, entity autocomplete, search, checkboxes, send disabled <2, summary '2 | 5 equipos', 3-step modal with back/next, instructions, create -> navigates /projects/{id}, multiproject-equipment-section/quotes/equipment-by-rif render correctly; consolidated quotes disappear from eligible list). UI issue: /multiprojects page renders without the Sidebar.

critical.issue: When the primary quote (quotes[0], earliest created_at) has branch_details, _create_project_from_quote turns the project into project_type='multistore' (quote_transitions.py L258-267) and the multirif block is skipped (L292 requires project_type != 'multistore'). Result: no rifs[], stores = only primary quote's branches; other quotes' RIF/sucursales are lost from the implementation tree (equipments_by_rif still OK). Reproduced in TestBranchDetailsPrimary. Fix: in multiprojects.py synth.update(...) also set branch_details=[] (and store_name kept in distribution) so the multirif path runs.

minor.issue: Project totals/matrix come only from the primary quote: total_usd, total_bs, box_count (UI shows 'Nro de Cajas 1' for a 2-quote project), services/banks/implementation_matrix, quote_number/Cotización Origen. Consolidated project should aggregate across all linked quotes.

Not atomic: quotes are archived/marked 'Enviada a Imple' BEFORE the project is created; if _create_project_from_quote fails (500) quotes are left archived with no project. Also two concurrent creates both pass eligibility; second fails on unique index of proyecto_cotizaciones (500) after creating a second project. Consider creating project first and claiming quotes with a conditional update (sent_to_implementation_at null) before proceeding.

ui_bugs.issue: Page does not render <Sidebar /> (other pages like Projects/ProjectDetail do), so the user loses app navigation on /multiprojects.

issues: Equipment lines (mono font, 11px) wrap heavily in the narrow third column; consider full-width section below the 3 cards.

action_items: Fix multirif override: in routes/multiprojects.py create, clear branch_details on the synthetic quote (synth['branch_details']=[]) so project_type stays 'multirif' with all RIFs/stores; re-run TestBranchDetailsPrimary
Aggregate total_usd/total_bs/box_count (and ideally services/matrix) across all consolidated quotes
Make create safer: create project first / atomically claim quotes to avoid half-archived state and race 500
critical_code_review_comments: multiprojects.py _build: eligibility recheck is non-atomic (TOCTOU) relative to the archive loop.
_create_project_from_quote is called with quote_id=primary; projects.quote_id only points to primary — fine since _linked_quote_ids also uses proyecto_cotizaciones.
entities level=rif loads up to 10000 clients unpaginated each time the chip is toggled; acceptable but could use server-side search.
Project creation triggers in-app 'Nuevo proyecto' push notification (seen as toast) — expected.

rca of the issue: quote_transitions._create_project_from_quote auto-converts any quote with branch_details into multistore before evaluating is_multirif; multiprojects.create deep-copies the primary quote (including its branch_details) into the synthetic quote, so the multirif branch is skipped.
